From rigid rules to customer-aware decisions

A three-way process treats uncertainty as a reason to investigate—not automatically approve or decline.

Traditional rules

Transaction → Rules → Approve or decline

False-decline riskAn unusual legitimate purchase may be declined.
Fraud-miss riskA subtle illegitimate purchase may be approved when it does not cross a rigid rule threshold.

AI-assisted process

Transaction → Behavioral risk analysis → Approve / Verify / Decline

Protect legitimate purchasesUncertain activity can be verified before a legitimate purchase is declined.
Prevent illegitimate purchasesCombined behavioral, device, location, merchant, and velocity signals can stop suspicious purchases that isolated rules may allow.
